description: This source file defines a test fixture class for functional testing of the Public API of the eShopOnWeb project. It customizes the web application host environment, replacing database contexts with in-memory databases for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestApiApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for setting up a testing environment for the Public API, particularly replacing database contexts with in-memory versions for isolated tests.

methods.description: Overrides the base method to configure the host environment, setting the environment to 'Testing' and replacing database contexts with in-memory databases.
